# Partial Monitoring Capacity

> Exact author-side quantum transmission rates with partial environmental observation and measurement-only helper communication.

Repository: GoGoKo699/Partial-Monitoring-Capacity. Start with README.md, STATUS.md and WORKSPACE.md. Physical entry: research/PHYSICAL_PICTURE.md. Scientific entry: research/MODEL_AND_CLAIMS.md, research/THEOREM.md, research/EXACT_PRODUCT_CAPACITY_2026-10-07.md, research/PROOF_AUDIT.md and research/OPTICAL_AUDIT.md. Contribution judgment and inspected comparisons: research/CONTRIBUTION_ASSESSMENT_2026-10-07.md. Prior-art depth: literature/PRIOR_ART.md. Current bounded task: work_orders/CURRENT.md.

Lead physical claim: in the interior qubit family, photon counting maximizes capacity over all predetermined product helper POVMs and all inputs, yet the stated example has a strictly larger unrestricted helper-assisted capacity. Both sides allow arbitrary endpoint block codes and only a classical helper-to-receiver message. Counting already reaches the positive-capacity boundary; the gap concerns rate. Adaptive local strategies and general separable block POVMs are excluded. Do not infer necessity of coherent helper memory or optical counting optimality. The optical energy ceiling is a supporting consequence of inaccessible loss.

Preserve the joint-register degrading hypothesis, collective helper resource, receiver-only classical record, unconditional error and average optical signal-energy budget. Do not weaken the hypothesis to marginal degradability or claim a practical receiver. Quoted rate tables are asymptotic, not measured hardware results. The spin-strip pilot is separate.

Original inputs and excerpts are pinned in provenance/IMPORT_MANIFEST.json. Run verify.py and the infrastructure tests without refreshing references. Also run checks/certify_product_capacity.py: this separate rational certificate encloses the example's scalar rates and gap, and does not prove the analytical POVM reduction. Archive records are historical, not live task instructions. Initialization was merged in PR #1; read STATUS and the actual live GitHub state for the current revision. The dated research/CLAIM_ASSESSMENT_2026-10-07.md and literature/PRIORITY_CHECK_2026-10-07.md record the completed bounded audit: unchanged rates, a direct instrument converse, and limited priority conclusions.

## Purpose and contact

This repository serves as a record of the work and a guide for the author’s self-directed learning. For discussion or potential collaboration, please contact Ruge Lin at [gogoko699@gmail.com](mailto:gogoko699@gmail.com).
